title: Echo Pulse — five real builds shipped
summary: A copy-ready daily update package for the BuiltByEcho social loop: combined Pulse proof system, Windows desktop beta release, Shield reply kit, product hotlinks, and npm/dev tooling proof.

builds.name: Echo Pulse update system
builds.shortUpdate: Combined the homepage command center, social handoff page, and machine-readable JSON feed into one proof-backed Echo Pulse update system.
builds.socialPost: Echo Pulse update: we combined the homepage board, social handoff page, and machine-readable JSON feed into one update system. The community gets a public proof board, the social team gets copy-ready posts, and agents/dashboards get structured data from the same source of truth.

builds.name: Windows desktop beta release
builds.shortUpdate: Released Echo Infer Desktop v1.0.0-beta.1 for Windows as an unsigned beta installer with verified build, typecheck, targeted tests, packaging, and downloaded-asset checksum match.
builds.socialPost: Echo Infer Desktop now has a Windows beta release. We packaged the desktop client, ran targeted provider/branding/close-policy tests, typecheck, production build, Windows NSIS packaging, and verified the published installer by downloading it back and matching the checksum.

builds.name: Echo Shield community reply kit
builds.shortUpdate: Added a Shield reply kit for Discord and X so scan results stay card-first, caveated, and easy to share.
builds.socialPost: Echo Shield got a community reply kit. The scanner page now includes safer templates for Discord and X: card first, score second, warnings in plain English, and a clear reminder that Echo reports signals instead of calling anything safe.

builds.name: Product follow-up hotlinks
builds.shortUpdate: Added product hotlinks so social posts can route people to Shield, the desktop beta, npm tooling, the update pack, and current builds fast.
builds.socialPost: The Products page now has a social follow-up hotlinks section. When a post mentions Echo Shield, the Windows desktop beta, npm tooling, current builds, or the Echo Pulse pack, there is a clean destination to send people instead of leaving them hunting through the site.

builds.name: npm/dev tooling proof
builds.shortUpdate: Kept the developer tooling lane visible with package links for briefs, run logs, API finding, repo digests, and storage SDKs.
builds.socialPost: Echo is also shipping the less-flashy rails that make agent work repeatable: repo briefs, run logs, API discovery, repo digests, and storage SDKs. The npm/dev tooling lane is now visible from the Products page so builders can follow the actual stack.
